rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for clapping your hands and, by extension, applauding.

example.english: We clap together after the performance.
example.jyutping: biu2 jin2 jyun4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 paak3 sau2

rows.note: Use this specifically for applauding a performer or speaker, especially in a public or more formal setting.

example.jyutping: cing2 gok3 wai6 wai4 gong2 ze2 gu2 zoeng2

rows.note: Use this when patting someone on the back or shoulder in encouragement or approval.

example.english: My boss gave me a friendly clap on the shoulder and told me to keep working hard.
example.traditional: 老闆拍咗我膊頭，叫我繼續努力。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 paak3 zo2 ngo5 bok3 tau4 giu3 ngo5 gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6

rows.note: Use this when two surfaces are brought forcefully together with a sharp impact.

example.english: The two planks came together with a sharp clap, making me jump.
example.traditional: 兩塊木板拍埋一聲，嚇咗我一跳。
example.jyutping: loeng5 faai3 muk6 baan2 paak3 maai4 jat1 seng1 haak3 zo2 ngo5 jat1 tiu3
